front_desk_hours: 24 hours a day, 7 days a week

Standard Queen.description: Comfortable room with a queen bed, work desk, smart TV, and city view.

Deluxe King.description: Spacious king room with a lounge chair, premium bedding, and partial bay view.

Executive Suite.beds: One king bed plus a sofa bed
Executive Suite.description: Separate living area, wet bar, two smart TVs, and full bay view. Includes lounge access.

Penthouse.description: Top-floor suite with wraparound terrace, dining room, and panoramic ocean view. Includes lounge access and airport transfer.

amenities: Outdoor rooftop pool and hot tub
On-site restaurant and bar (The Horizon Room)

policies.check_in: Check-in starts at 3:00 PM. Early check-in is subject to availability.
policies.check_out: Check-out is by 11:00 AM. Late check-out until 2:00 PM may be arranged for a fee.
policies.cancellation: Free cancellation up to 48 hours before the check-in date. Cancellations inside 48 hours are charged one night plus tax.
policies.deposit: A one-night deposit is authorized on the card at the time of booking.
policies.payment: We accept all major credit cards. A valid photo ID and the card used for booking are required at check-in.
policies.minimum_age: Guests must be at least 21 years old to check in.
policies.pets: Dogs under 50 pounds are welcome in pet-friendly rooms for a 75 dollar per stay cleaning fee. Service animals stay free.
policies.smoking: All rooms and indoor areas are non-smoking. A 250 dollar cleaning fee applies to smoking in a room.
policies.parking: Valet parking is 45 dollars per night. Self parking is 30 dollars per night.
policies.resort_fee: A 25 dollar per night resort fee covers Wi-Fi, pool, and fitness center access.
policies.extra_guests: Rates are for up to two guests. Each additional guest is 25 dollars per night.

faqs.airport_distance: Grand Horizon Hotel is about 10 minutes from San Diego International Airport.
faqs.airport_shuttle: A complimentary airport shuttle runs every 30 minutes between 5 AM and 11 PM.
faqs.breakfast: Breakfast is served in The Horizon Room from 6:30 AM to 10:30 AM and is 22 dollars per person, or included with Executive Suite and Penthouse bookings.
faqs.wifi: High-speed Wi-Fi is complimentary for all guests in rooms and public areas.
faqs.pool_hours: The rooftop pool is open daily from 7 AM to 10 PM.
faqs.parking_details: Both valet and self parking are available on site. See the parking policy for rates.
faqs.accessible_rooms: Accessible rooms with roll-in showers are available in every room type. Please request one when booking.
faqs.nearby: The hotel is within walking distance of the Gaslamp Quarter, the convention center, and the waterfront.
